featuresSectionDescription: Everything you need to understand and optimize your product costs.
featureLayerDescription: Break down complex recipes into individual components. See exactly where your money goes.
featureUpdatesDescription: Change an ingredient price and watch it ripple through every recipe automatically.
featureMarginDescription: Set your target margins and instantly see which products are hitting the mark.
featureCompoundDescription: Build recipes from other recipes. Perfect for bakeries, restaurants, and manufacturers.
demoUpdatesHint: Change any value to see others update
whyFreeReason1Before: I built Costra because I needed it myself. I started a
whyFreeReason1After: back in April 2025 and I've needed a quick way to find the cost of new recipes.
whyFreeReason2: Charging for it felt wrong. The people who need this most are often the ones who can least afford another subscription.
howFreeItem1: No backend — your data is stored locally in your browser
howFreeItem2: No servers to maintain means no costs to pass on
howFreeItem3: I don't even have a domain name for it
howFreeItem4: Built as a passion project, not a business
futurePlansIntroAfter: . But if enough people want features that require ongoing costs, I'd consider an optional paid tier on top.
